name: mod-settings-off
about: Every module's switch off and on again with every package installed, through the settings_offtests bot, each checked by what the module does in game: its town units gone and back (campaign portal after a town rebuild, farm, fishing coast, gambler, notice board, roulette wheel, wave statue, way gates, a dye bucket's map icon), its status line, its effect (a trap arrow's tint, a hovered buff's tip, the item over a Skill Trainer, the class hidden at create-character, the Title Bonuses buff, the stash sort button, the HoH1 trinkets in the drops, a level 4 tavern's 4th drink), two Bandit Keep floors with the run modules off then on (abyss crack, strongbox, key chest art, objectives, the keep puzzle, deathrecap's line on a death) and a Firearms character's orb warnings. classes is parked: only its stored value. Then every switch is on again and no script errors from HWP files.
